Get tableY

Source: R/AllGenerics.R
tableY.Rd

Get tableY

Usage

tableY(x, ...)

Arguments

x

input object

...

additional arguments

Value

tableY slot of x

Examples

x <- randomWeb(10)
tableY(x)
